payload.title: Index cards show no cover when the original file is missing
payload.description: Machines on Machines 2026-11-09: four stories' cards were coverless while the article page showed the picture. Cause 1: save-version --images renumbered a changed picture (chart.png to chart-2.png) and rewrote the body but left the front-matter image on the old path, which the site never held (it predates media.originals, and an unchanged re-upload sends no bucket event). Cause 2: cards drew the front-matter path itself, so a missing original meant no cover. Fix branch fix/card-image-src: save-version moves front-matter card pictures with the body; every page img that names a stored picture uses the rendition the article page uses. Related: PPY-dc320c7d (hotlinked images).
